questions.q: What IS this feature in one sentence?
questions.a: Footstep audio per surface type. Sand rock and metal each have distinct frequency profiles.

questions.q: What physical constraint does it encode?
questions.a: Sand footstep peaks at 200-800Hz. Rock at 800-2000Hz. Metal at 2000-5000Hz. Amplitude scales with player velocity.

questions.q: What is the ONE measurement that proves it works?
questions.a: A player walking on sand produces a 200-800Hz sound. A player walking on metal produces a 2000-5000Hz sound.

questions.q: What wall must it never violate?
questions.a: Must produce consistent verifiable results. Must not crash.
